paragraphs: We serve the housing finance industry by providing private mortgage insurance and reinsurance, and title insurance and settlement services to mortgage lenders, borrowers and investors to support homeownership. We conduct our operations through two primary business segments: Mortgage Insurance and Reinsurance.

Our Mortgage Insurance segment offers private mortgage insurance for mortgages secured by residential properties located in the United States. We provide private mortgage insurance on residential first-lien mortgage loans in the U.S. ("mortgage insurance") through Essent Guaranty, a Pennsylvania-domiciled monoline mortgage guaranty insurance company licensed in all 50 states and the District of Columbia and approved by Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, and also offer other credit risk management solutions, including contract underwriting, to our customers. For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, we generated private mortgage insurance new insurance written, or NIW, of approximately $46.6 billion, $45.6 billion and $47.7 billion, respectively. As of December 31, 2025, we had approximately $248.4 billion of private mortgage insurance in force.

Our Reinsurance segment primarily reinsures U.S. mortgage risk in the GSE credit risk transfer market and provides underwriting consulting services to third-party reinsurers ("GSE and other risk share") through Bermuda-based Essent Re, a Class 3B insurer regulated by the Bermuda Monetary Authority. As of December 31, 2025, Essent Re provided insurance or reinsurance relating to GSE credit risk transfer and other reinsurance transactions covering approximately $2.3 billion of risk.

Prior to December 31, 2025, we disclosed one reportable segment, Mortgage Insurance, which was comprised of "U.S. mortgage insurance" and "GSE and other mortgage risk share." Our mortgage insurance business and GSE and other mortgage risk share business each represented operating segments that were aggregated and disclosed as one reportable segment based on their shared economic characteristics and the similarities between the two operating segments. In the fourth quarter of 2025, Essent Re entered the Lloyd's of London market to reinsure certain property and casualty risks beginning in the first quarter of 2026. Considering the expansion of business and types of risks reinsured at Essent Re, our Chief Operating Decision Maker began to assess the performance of all third-party reinsurance as an operating segment as of December 31, 2025. To reflect this change, the GSE and other mortgage risk share operating segment is no longer aggregated with mortgage insurance and all third-party reinsurance is now disclosed as a separate reportable segment: Reinsurance. All prior period segment information has been recast to conform to the new segment presentation.

We also offer title insurance products both directly and through a network of title insurance agents, as well as title and settlement services. This operating segment was established upon our acquisitions of Agents National Title Insurance Company (renamed Essent Title Insurance, Inc. effective January 1, 2025), a Pennsylvania-domiciled title insurance underwriter licensed in 45 states and the District of Columbia, and Boston National Title, a national title agency, on July 1, 2023. Our title insurance operations are included in "Corporate and Other" within our segment-related disclosures.
See Notes 1 and 18 of the Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements for further details of our businesses.

Essent Group Ltd. was organized as a limited liability company under the laws of Bermuda on July 1, 2008. Essent Group's registered office is located at Clarendon House, 2 Church Street, Hamilton HM11, Bermuda and our telephone number is (441) 297-9901. Our corporate website address is www.essentgroup.com. Our annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q and current reports on Form 8-K and other information filed by us with the SEC are available, without charge, on our website as soon as reasonably practicable after they are filed electronically with the SEC. Copies are also available, without charge, by writing to Secretary, Essent Group Ltd., Clarendon House, 2 Church Street, Hamilton HM11, Bermuda. The information on our corporate website is not a part of this Annual Report.

Private mortgage insurance plays a critical role in the U.S. housing finance system, extending affordable homeownership by facilitating the sale of low down payment loans into the secondary market. Federal National Mortgage Association ("Fannie Mae") and Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation ("Freddie Mac"), which we refer to together as the GSEs, are U.S. Federal government-sponsored enterprises which purchase residential mortgages from banks and other lenders and guaranty mortgage-backed securities that are offered to investors in the secondary mortgage market. The GSEs are restricted by their charters from purchasing or guaranteeing low down payment loans, defined as loans with less than a 20% down payment, that are not covered by certain credit protections. Private mortgage insurance satisfies the GSEs' credit protection requirements for low down payment loans. Essent and other private mortgage insurers provide credit protection to lenders and mortgage investors, supporting a robust secondary mortgage market in the United States by covering a portion of the unpaid principal balance of a mortgage and certain related expenses in the event of a default. In doing so, we provide private capital to mitigate mortgage credit risk, allowing lenders to make additional mortgage financing available to prospective homeowners.

The U.S. residential mortgage market is one of the largest in the world, with over $14.6 trillion of debt outstanding as of September 30, 2025, and includes a range of private and government-sponsored participants. Private industry participants include mortgage banks, mortgage brokers, commercial, regional and investment banks, savings institutions, credit unions, REITs, mortgage insurers and other financial institutions. Public participants include government agencies such as the Federal Housing Administration (FHA), the Veterans Administration (VA), the U.S. Department of Agriculture Rural Development program and the Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae), as well as government-sponsored enterprises such as Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac. The U.S. residential mortgage market encompasses both primary and secondary markets. The primary market consists of lenders originating home loans to borrowers, and includes loans made to support home purchases, which are referred to as purchase originations, and loans made to refinance existing mortgages, which are referred to as refinancing originations. The secondary market includes institutions buying and selling mortgages in the form of whole loans or securitized assets such as mortgage-backed securities.

The GSEs are the most prominent participants in the secondary mortgage market, buying residential mortgages from banks and other primary lenders as part of their government mandate to provide liquidity and stability in the U.S. housing finance system. According to the Federal Reserve, the GSEs held or guaranteed approximately $6.7 trillion, or 45.7%, of all U.S. residential mortgage debt outstanding as of September 30, 2025. The charters of the GSEs generally prohibit the GSEs from purchasing a low down payment loan unless that loan is insured by a GSE-approved mortgage insurer, the mortgage seller retains at least a 10% participation in the loan or the seller agrees to repurchase or replace the loan in the event of a default. Historically, private mortgage insurance has been the preferred method utilized to meet this GSE charter requirement. As a result, the private mortgage insurance industry in the United States is driven in large part by the business practices and mortgage insurance requirements of the GSEs.

Mortgage insurance plays a critical role in the U.S. residential mortgage market by facilitating secondary market sales and providing lenders and investors a means to diversify their exposures and mitigate mortgage credit risk. Mortgage insurance is offered by both private companies, such as Essent Guaranty, and government agencies, such as the FHA and the VA. From 2006 through 2025, an average of 32.0% of total annual U.S. mortgage origination volume utilized mortgage insurance.

Mortgage insurance industry volumes are influenced by total mortgage originations and the mix between purchase and refinancing originations. Historically, mortgage insurance utilization has been meaningfully higher in purchase originations compared to refinancing originations. In 2025, total U.S. residential mortgage origination volume was estimated to be $2.05 trillion, comprised of $1.36 trillion of purchase originations and $0.69 trillion of refinancing originations. The mortgage market in 2025 continued to be substantially and negatively impacted by elevated mortgage interest rates, precipitated in large part by actions of the Federal Reserve commencing in 2022 that were intended to combat inflation, as well as high housing prices and constrained supply.

headings: Risks Relating to the Operation of Our Businesses

Intense competition within the private mortgage insurance industry could result in the loss of customers, lower premiums, wider credit guidelines and other changes which could lower our revenues or raise our costs.
Our revenues, profitability and returns would decline if we lose a significant customer.
The amount of insurance we may be able to write could be adversely affected if lenders and investors select alternatives to private mortgage insurance.
If the volume of low down payment home mortgage originations declines, the amount of mortgage insurance that we write could decline, which would reduce our revenues.
We expect our claims to increase as our portfolio matures.

Because we establish loss reserves only upon a loan default rather than based on estimates of our ultimate losses on risk in force, losses may have a disproportionate adverse effect on our earnings in certain periods.

If interest rates decline, house prices appreciate or mortgage insurance cancellation requirements change, the length of time that our policies remain in force could decline and cause a decline in our revenue.
The premiums we charge may not be adequate to compensate us for our liabilities for losses and, as a result, any inadequacy could materially affect our financial condition and results of operations.
Competition in the title insurance and settlement services industry may adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
Our success depends, in part, on our ability to manage risks in our investment portfolio.
Because loss reserve estimates are subject to uncertainties and are based on assumptions that may be volatile, ultimate losses may be substantially different than our loss reserves.
Our results could be adversely affected by catastrophic events.
Underwriting risks and reserving for losses in our non-mortgage reinsurance business are based on actuarially determined methods and assumptions, which are subject to inherent uncertainties.
A downgrade in our financial strength ratings may adversely affect the amount of business that we write.
If servicers fail to adhere to appropriate servicing standards or experience disruptions to their businesses, our losses could unexpectedly increase.
Our delegated underwriting program may subject our mortgage insurance business to unanticipated claims.
We face risks associated with our contract underwriting business.
Our information technology systems may become outmoded, be temporarily interrupted or fail thereby causing us to fail to meet our customers' demands.
The security of our information technology systems may be compromised and confidential information, including non-public personal information that we maintain, could be improperly disclosed.
We are exposed to risks associated with our title insurance and settlement services business that could negatively affect our results of operations and financial condition.
We may not be able to collect all amounts due to us from reinsurers and reinsurance coverage may not be available to us in the future at commercially reasonable rates or at all.
Risks Relating to Regulation and Litigation
The amount of insurance we write could be adversely affected by the Dodd-Frank Act's risk retention requirements and the definition of Qualified Residential Mortgage ("QRM").
The implementation of the Basel rules may discourage the use of mortgage insurance.
Our operating insurance and reinsurance subsidiaries are subject to regulation in various jurisdictions, and material changes in the regulation of their operations could adversely affect us.
paragraphs: Our current business and future results may be affected by a number of risks and uncertainties, including those described below. The risks and uncertainties described below are not the only risks and uncertainties we face. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial also may impair our business operations. If any of the following risks actually occur, our business, results of operations and financial condition could suffer. The risks discussed below also include forward-looking statements and our actual results may differ substantially from those discussed in these forward-looking statements.

The private mortgage insurance industry is intensely competitive, with six private mortgage insurers currently approved and eligible to write business for the GSEs. We compete with other private mortgage insurers on the basis of pricing, terms and conditions, underwriting guidelines, loss mitigation practices, financial strength, reputation, customer relationships, service and other factors. One or more private mortgage insurers may seek increased market share from government-supported insurance programs, such as those sponsored by the FHA, or from other private mortgage insurers by reducing pricing, loosening their underwriting guidelines or relaxing their risk management practices, which could, in turn, improve their competitive position in the industry and negatively impact our level of NIW. A decline in industry NIW might result in increased competition as certain private mortgage insurance companies may seek to maintain their NIW levels within a smaller market. In addition, the perceived increase in the credit quality of loans that currently are being insured, the relative financial strength of the existing mortgage insurance companies and the possibility of the private mortgage insurance market acquiring a greater share of the overall mortgage insurance market may encourage new entrants into the private mortgage insurance industry, which could further increase competition in our business.

Our mortgage insurance business depends on our relationships with our largest lending customers. Our top ten customers generated 59.3% of our NIW during year ended December 31, 2025, compared to 50.2% and 39.9% for the years ended December 31, 2024 and 2023, respectively. For the year ended December 31, 2025, one customer represented more than 10% of our consolidated revenues. Maintaining our business relationships and business volumes with our largest lending customers remains critical to the success of our business.

Our master policies do not, and by law cannot, require our customers to do business with us. Under the terms of our master policy, our customers, or the parties they designate to service the loans we insure, have the unilateral right to cancel our insurance coverage at any time for any loan that we insure. Upon cancellation of coverage, subject to the type of coverage, we may be required to refund unearned premiums, if any.

In addition, adverse macroeconomic conditions could subject customers to serious financial constraints that may jeopardize the viability of their business plans or their access to additional capital, forcing them to consider alternatives such as bankruptcy or consolidation with others in the industry. Other factors, such as rising interest rates, which could reduce mortgage origination volumes generally, rising costs associated with regulatory compliance and the relative cost of capital, may also result in consolidation among our customers. In the event our customers consolidate, they may revisit their relationships with individual private mortgage insurers, such as us, which could result in a loss of customers or a reduction in our business. The loss of business from a significant customer could have a material adverse effect on the amount of new business we are able to write, and consequently, our revenue, and we can provide no assurance that any loss of business from a significant customer would be replaced from other new or existing lending customers.

We compete for business with alternatives to private mortgage insurance, consisting primarily of government-supported mortgage insurance programs as well as home purchase or refinancing alternatives that do not use any form of mortgage insurance.

paragraphs: 本公司服務住宅貸款金融產業，提供私人房貸保險與再保險、以及房貸貸款人、借款人與投資者之標題保險與結清服務，以支持住宅所有權。本公司透過兩個主要業務分部進行營運：房貸保險與再保險。

房貸保險分部提供美國住宅不動產抵押貸款之私人房貸保險。本公司透過Essent Guaranty，一家位於賓夕法尼亞州的單線房貸擔保保險公司，並在美國50州與華盛頓特區取得執照，且獲得房利美與房地美批准，提供美國住宅首優先抵押貸款之私人房貸保險（"房貸保險"），並提供其他信用風險管理解決方案，包括契約承保，給我們的客戶。截至2025年12月31日，我們產生約466億美元之私人房貸保險新保單寫入（NIW），2024年為456億美元，2023年為477億美元。截至2025年12月31日，本公司持有約2,484億美元之私人房貸保險在劵。
再保險分部主要再保險美國房貸風險於GSE信用風險轉移市場，並透過位於百慕達的Essent Re，一家百慕達金融管理局監管的Class 3B保險公司，為第三方再保險公司（"GSE及其他風險分享"）提供承保諮詢服務。截至2025年12月31日，Essent Re提供與GSE信用風險轉移及其他再保險交易相關之保險或再保險，覆蓋約23億美元之風險。

在2025年12月31日之前，本公司披露一個應報告分部，房貸保險，包含"美國房貸保險"與"GSE及其他房貸風險分享"。本公司之房貸保險業務與GSE及其他房貸風險分享業務各自代表運營分部，因經濟特徵相似而被歸類為一個應報告分部。在2025年第四季，Essent Re進入倫敦勞埃德市場，自2026年第一季開始再保險某些財產與意外風險。考慮Essent Re業務擴張與再保險風險類型，本公司首席營運決策者自2025年12月31日起開始評估所有第三方再保險作為運營分部。為反映此變更，GSE及其他房貸風險分享運營分部不再與房貸保險歸類，所有第三方再保險現已作為獨立應報告分部：再保險。所有往期分部資訊已重新整理以符合新分部呈現方式。

本公司亦提供標題保險產品，直接銷售並透過標題保險經紀人網路，以及標題與結清服務。此運營分部於2023年7月1日，透過收購Agents National Title Insurance Company（於2025年1月1日起更名為Essent Title Insurance, Inc.），一家位於賓夕法尼亞州的標題保險承保人，並在45州與華盛頓特區取得執照，以及Boston National Title，一家全國性標題經紀公司而設立。本公司之標題保險業務包含於"公司與其他"之分部相關揭露中。
有關本公司業務之進一步細節，請參閱財務會計彙編附註第1與第18項。

Essent Group Ltd. 於2008年7月1日根據百慕達法律設立為有限責任公司。Essent Group之註冊辦公室位於百慕達漢密爾頓市Clarendon House，2 Church Street，Hamilton HM11，本公司電話為(441) 297-9901。本公司網站為www.essentgroup.com。Essent Group向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交年度報告（Form 10-K）、季報（Form 10-Q）與現況報告（Form 8-K）及其他資訊。SEC維護網站（http://www.sec.gov），包含發行者（包括本公司）提交之報告、股東信函與資訊聲明等資訊。本公司提交之年度報告（Form 10-K）、季報（Form 10-Q）與現況報告（Form 8-K）及其他資訊，自提交至SEC後，盡速於本公司網站提供，不收取費用。亦可透過書面寄送至祕書，Essent Group Ltd.，Clarendon House，2 Church Street，Hamilton HM11，百慕達取得副本。本公司網站資訊並非本年度報告之一部分。

私人房貸保險在美國住宅貸款金融體系中扮演關鍵角色，透過促進低押金貸款進入次級市場，擴展負擔得起的住宅所有權。美國聯邦住宅貸款銀行（"房利美"）與美國聯邦住房貸款銀行（"房地美"），我們稱之為GSEs，為美國聯邦政府支持企業，從銀行及其他貸款人購買住宅貸款，並擔保提供給次級貸款市場投資者的貸款擔保證券。GSEs根據其章程限制，不得購買或擔保未被特定信用保護覆蓋之低押金貸款，定義為押金低於20%之貸款。私人房貸保險滿足GSEs對低押金貸款之信用保護要求。Essent及其他私人房貸保險公司為貸款人與房貸投資者提供信用保護，透過覆蓋貸款違約時之未償還貸款本金與相關費用，支持美國強健之次級貸款市場。透過此方式，本公司提供私人資本以緩解房貸信用風險，使貸款人能為潛在購屋者提供更多房貸融資。

美國住宅房貸市場是全球最大的市場之一，截至2025年9月30日，未償還債務總額超過14.6兆美元，並包含私人及政府支持的參與者。私人產業參與者包括房貸銀行、房貸經紀、商業銀行、地區銀行、投資銀行、儲蓄機構、信用合作社、REITs、房貸保險公司及其他金融機構。公部門參與者包括政府機構，例如美國住房管理局（FHA）、退伍軍人管理局（VA）、美國農業部鄉村發展計畫以及政府國家房貸協會（Ginnie Mae），以及政府支持企業，例如房利美（Fannie Mae）和房地美（Freddie Mac）。美國住宅房貸市場涵蓋主要市場與次級市場。主要市場由貸款人向借款人發放住宅貸款組成，包括用以支持購屋的貸款，稱為購屋貸款發放，以及用以重新貸款現有房貸的貸款，稱為重新貸款發放。次級市場包括買賣房貸的機構，以整筆貸款或結構化資產形式進行交易，例如房貸-backed證券。

政府支持企業（GSEs）是次級房貸市場中最顯著的參與者，根據其政府使命，他們會從銀行及其他主要貸款人處購買住宅房貸，以提供美國住房金融體系的流動性與穩定性。根據聯邦儲備系統的資料，截至2025年9月30日，GSEs持有或擔保約6.7兆美元，佔美國住宅房貸未償還債務總額的45.7%。GSEs的章程通常禁止其購買低押金貸款，除非該貸款由GSE核准的房貸保險公司承保、貸款賣方至少保留10%的貸款參與權，或賣方同意在貸款違約時買回或更換貸款。歷史上，私人房貸保險一直是用以符合GSE章程要求的首選方法。因此，美國的私人房貸保險產業在很大程度上受到GSEs的業務做法與房貸保險要求的影響。
房貸保險在美國住宅房貸市場中扮演關鍵角色，透過促進次級市場銷售，並為貸款人與投資者提供一種分散風險與降低房貸信用風險的方法。房貸保險由私人公司，例如Essent Guaranty，以及政府機構，例如FHA與VA提供。從2006年至2025年，平均每年美國房貸發放量中約有32.0%使用了房貸保險。

房貸保險產業的規模受到總房貸發放量以及購屋與重新貸款發放比例的影響。歷史上，購屋貸款發放的房貸保險使用率明顯高於重新貸款發放。2025年，美國住宅房貸發放量估計為2.05兆美元，其中購屋貸款發放為1.36兆美元，重新貸款發放為0.69兆美元。2025年的房貸市場持續受到高房貸利率的顯著負面影響，這主要由聯邦儲備系統自2022年起採取的行動所導致，這些行動旨在對抗通貨膨脹，以及高房價與供應受限的情況。
下圖提供總住宅房貸發放量的趨勢細節，並說明購屋與重新貸款發放量在市場中的分佈。

headings: 與本公司業務運作相關的風險
私人房貸保險產業內激烈的競爭可能導致客戶流失、 premiums 降低、信用審核標準放寬及其他變動，這些變動可能降低我們的營業收入或提高我們的成本。
若我們失去重要的客戶，將導致我們的營業收入、獲利能力及回報率下降。
若貸款人及投資人選擇私人房貸保險的替代方案，我們可能寫出的保險金額可能會受到不利影響。
若低押金房貸發放量下降，我們寫出的房貸保險金額也可能下降，這將導致我們的營業收入減少。
我們預期隨著我們的資產組合成熟，我們的理賠金額將會增加。
因為我們僅在貸款違約時才建立損失準備金，而非根據我們在風險中風險的最終損失進行估計，因此在某些期間，損失可能對我們的營收產生不成比例的負面影響。
若利率下降、房價上漲或房貸保險取消要求變更，我們的保單持續有效期間可能會縮短，導致我們的營業收入下降。
本公司所收取的保費可能無法足夠彌補我們因損失而產生的責任，因此任何不足的情況都可能對本公司財務狀況及營運成果造成重大影響。
在不動產保險及過戶服務產業中的競爭可能對本公司業務、財務狀況及營運成果產生不利影響。
本公司成功在一定程度上取決於我們管理投資組合風險的能力。
因為損失準備金的估計值受到不確定性影響，且基於可能波動的假設，最終的損失可能與我們的損失準備金有顯著差異。
本公司營運成果可能因重大災難事件而受到不利影響。
本公司非房貸再保險業務的承保風險及損失準備金，係基於精算確定的方法與假設，而這些方法與假設本身存在內在的不確定性。
本公司財務強度評級若遭降級，可能對本公司所能承作的業務量產生不利影響。
若貸款服務機構未能遵循適當的貸款服務標準或其業務遭遇中斷，本公司可能意外面臨更高的損失。
本公司委託承銷計畫可能使我們的房貸保險業務面臨未預期的理賠請求。
我們面臨與合約承銷業務相關的風險。
我們的資訊科技系統可能變得過時、暫時中斷或失敗，因而導致我們無法滿足客戶的需求。
我們的資訊科技系統安全性可能受到威脅，且我們所維護的機密資訊，包括非公開個人資訊，可能被不當揭露。
我們面臨與房貸保險及過戶服務業務相關的風險，這些風險可能對我們的營運成果與財務狀況產生負面影響。
我們可能無法從再保險公司收取所有應收金額，且未來再保險覆蓋可能無法以商業合理價格或任何價格提供給我們。
與規範及訴訟相關的風險
我們所承保的保險金額可能因《多德-弗蘭克法案》的風險保留要求及「合格住宅貸款」（"QRM"）的定義而受到不利影響。
Basel 規則的實施可能會抑制房貸保險的使用。
本公司營運的保險及再保險子公司受各司法管轄區的監管，其營運規範的重大變更可能對本公司造成不利影響。
paragraphs: 本公司目前的業務及未來績效可能受多種風險與不確定性影響，包括下列所列風險與不確定性。下列所列風險與不確定性並非本公司所面臨的唯一風險與不確定性。尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未為本公司所知或本公司認為不重要，也可能影響本公司業務運作。若下列任一風險實際發生，將可能使本公司業務、營運成果與財務狀況受損。下列所討論的風險亦包含預測性陳述，而本公司實際結果可能與預測性陳述中所討論者有顯著差異。

私人房貸保險產業競爭激烈，目前有六傢俬人房貸保險公司已獲批准且有資格為GSEs提供業務。本公司與其他私人房貸保險公司競爭，競爭基礎包括價格、條款與條件、承保準則、損失緩衝措施、財務實力、聲譽、客戶關係、服務及其他因素。一或多間私人房貸保險公司可能透過降低價格、放寬承保準則或放鬆風險管理措施，爭取來自政府支持的保險計畫（如由FHA主辦的計畫）或其他私人房貸保險公司的市場佔有率，這可能會改善其在產業中的競爭地位，並對本公司NIW的水準造成負面影響。產業NIW下降可能導致部分私人房貸保險公司為維持其NIW水準而在較小的市場中尋求競爭。此外，目前被保險貸款的信用品質被認為有所提升、現有房貸保險公司的財務實力，以及私人房貸保險市場可能佔據更大整體房貸保險市場份額的可能性，可能會鼓勵新進者進入私人房貸保險產業，這可能會進一步增加本公司業務的競爭。
本公司房貸保險業務依賴與最大貸款客戶的關係。本公司前十大客戶於2025年12月31日財年間，產生了59.3%的NIW，與2024年12月3、2023年12月31日財年間的50.2%及39.9%相比。於2025年12月31日財年間，單一客戶佔本公司合併營收的10%以上。維持與最大貸款客戶的業務關係與業務規模，對本公司業務的成功至關重要。
本公司主政策並不，且依法不能，要求客戶與本公司進行業務。根據本公司主政策的條款，客戶或其指定用以服務我們所保險貸款的當事人，有權隨時無條件取消我們的保險覆蓋，針對我們所保險的任何貸款。在取消覆蓋後，根據覆蓋類型，本公司可能需退還未收取的保費（如有）。

此外，惡劣的總體經濟條件可能使客戶面臨嚴重的財務限制，可能危及他們的業務計畫或取得額外資金的渠道，迫使他們考慮其他替代方案，例如破產或與產業內其他公司合併。其他因素，例如利率上升，可能導致房貸發放量普遍減少，與監管合規相關的成本上升，以及相對資金成本，也可能導致客戶之間的合併。若本公司客戶合併，他們可能會重新評估與個別私人房貸保險公司（例如本公司）的關係，這可能會導致客戶流失或本公司業務減少。來自重要客戶的業務流失可能對本公司能夠承做新業務的數量造成重大負面影響，進而影響本公司營收，本公司無法保證任何來自重要客戶的業務流失會被其他新或現有貸款客戶所取代。
本公司與私人房貸保險的替代方案競爭，這些替代方案主要為政府支持的房貸保險計畫，以及不使用任何形式房貸保險的房屋購買新貸款或重新貸款替代方案。
